select m.PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO m LEFT JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO n ON m.PORTFOLIO_ID=n.PORTFOLIO_ID where ${sqlWhere} and MDATE>date_format('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') AND PORTFOLIO_TYPE IN ('01','02')
and m.PORTFOLIO_ID not in (select distinct PORTFOLIO_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR)
